$comment: Run-identity derivation for cloister/execution/v1. A run's name is derived from the authority that admitted it, never chosen by the caller, so a second implementation can compute the name locally and address a run without waiting for `start` to return. Each case pins the exact preimage bytes, so an implementation checks its field framing and its hash independently.

derivation.encoding: domain || 0x00 || for each field in (canonicalSpecDigest, grantId, replayKey): u64le(byteLength(field)) || utf8(field)
notes: canonicalSpecDigest is the ASCII 'blake3-256:<hex>' digest of the RunSpec's Cap'n Proto CANONICAL form, not of the received wire bytes — segment layout and padding are an encoder's choice, not content.

Fields are length-prefixed because a bare concatenation is ambiguous at the boundaries: (grantId 'ab', replayKey 'c') and (grantId 'a', replayKey 'bc') would otherwise share one run identity. The two field-boundary cases below hold that apart.
The domain separator scopes the digest to this derivation so it can never collide with another BLAKE3 preimage in the substrate.
